name: @git-qa/desktop
description: 検証中の画面をライブで見て、その場で判定を置くためのデスクトップ画面

scripts.bundle:host: esbuild ../host/src/app-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=src-tauri/resources/host-bundle.mjs && pnpm bundle:ocr && pnpm bundle:input && pnpm bundle:record
scripts.bundle:ocr: xcrun swiftc -O ../adapter-desktop/tools/ocr.swift -o src-tauri/resources/git-qa-ocr || echo '[git-qa] OCR を建てられない（段 2 は無しで進む）'
scripts.bundle:input: cargo build --release --manifest-path ../adapter-desktop/tools/input/Cargo.toml && cp ../adapter-desktop/tools/input/target/release/git-qa-input src-tauri/resources/git-qa-input || echo '[git-qa] 触る道具を建てられない（前面へ出す道で進む）'
scripts.bundle:record: xcrun swiftc -O ../adapter-desktop/tools/record.swift -o src-tauri/resources/git-qa-record || echo '[git-qa] 窓を録る道具を建てられない（録画は unsupported で進む）'
